data.title: Bitmine Climbs 6% as Ethereum Extends Rally After SEC Tokenization Order; Sharplink Rises 5%, Coinbase Jumps 6%
data.description: An SEC order carving out a regulated path for tokenized U.S. stocks just sent Ethereum surging and lit a fire under a handful of crypto equities, but the connection between that rulebook and these stock gains runs through a far thinner thread than most traders realize.
data.keywords: Coinbase, Coinbase Global, SharpLink, formal rulemaking, Ethereum, Bitmine
